brand.description: Fizzo is Hyderabad's playful take on the nostalgic Indian soda: bold, bubbly flavours like Jeera, Paan and Chilli Mango that you won't find on a national brand's shelf. Artificially flavoured and proud of it, made for street-side cravings, biryani lunches and everyday fun.
brand.labelNote: All Fizzo beverages are artificially flavoured. Please see the bottle label for full ingredients.
brand.metaDescription: Meet Fizzo, bold desi sodas from Fresh 360: Lime, Orange, Blue Mojito, Jeera, Chilli Mango, Root Beer, Sugandhi and Paan. Artificially flavoured. Made in Hyderabad.
brand.socialCaption: Eight flavours. Zero boring. Meet Fizzo, the fizz with masti. #Fizzo #Fresh360 #DesiSoda

products.name: Lime
products.tagline: The classic nimbu soda, turned up.
products.description: Sharp, zesty and ice-cold. Fizzo Lime is the thirst-quencher you grew up on, with a tangy bite and a clean, crisp finish.
products.servingSuggestion: Hot afternoons, fried snacks, a plate of chaat
labelStatements: CONTAINS CLASS II PRESERVATIVE (INS 211, sodium benzoate)
